cancelButtonProps.zh-CN: 取消按钮的属性。autoFocus 为 true 时打开后聚焦该按钮；class、style 落在按钮上；onClick 先于内置的取消处理调用，不会替换内置处理。
cancelButtonProps.en-US: Props of the cancel button. autoFocus focuses it on open; class and style land on the button; onClick runs before the built-in cancel handling, which still runs.

cancelLoading.zh-CN: 取消按钮是否加载中；不传时跟随 onCancel 返回的 Promise，显式传入 false 关闭该行为。
cancelLoading.en-US: Whether the cancel button is loading. When omitted it follows the Promise returned by onCancel; pass false to turn that off.

cancelText.zh-CN: 取消按钮文字，缺省取语言包 Modal.cancel。
cancelText.en-US: Cancel button text. Defaults to the locale entry Modal.cancel.

centered.en-US: Whether the dialog is vertically centered.

closable.zh-CN: 是否显示右上角的关闭按钮。
closable.en-US: Whether the close button in the corner is shown.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 是否允许按 Esc 取消对话框。

confirmLoading.zh-CN: 确认按钮是否加载中；不传时跟随 onOk 返回的 Promise，显式传入 false 关闭该行为。
confirmLoading.en-US: Whether the ok button is loading. When omitted it follows the Promise returned by onOk; pass false to turn that off.

footerFill.zh-CN: 默认页脚的两个按钮是否撑满排列。
footerFill.en-US: Whether the two buttons of the default footer fill the row.

fullScreen.zh-CN: 是否全屏显示，开启后 width、height 不再生效。
fullScreen.en-US: Whether the dialog fills the screen. width and height are ignored.

getPopupContainer.zh-CN: 指定弹层渲染到的父级 DOM。自定义容器需要设置 position: relative；这会改变浮层的 DOM 位置，不改变视图位置。
getPopupContainer.en-US: Parent element the dialog is rendered into. A custom container needs position: relative; this changes where the dialog sits in the DOM, not where it is shown.

hasCancel.zh-CN: 默认页脚是否显示取消按钮。
hasCancel.en-US: Whether the default footer shows the cancel button.

height.zh-CN: 对话框高度，数字按像素处理，字符串为合法 CSS 长度。
height.en-US: Height of the dialog. A number is in pixels; a string is any valid CSS length.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 关闭时是否保留对话框内部节点而不销毁。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether the dialog content stays mounted while closed.

lazyRender.zh-CN: 配合 keepDOM 使用；为 true 时，首次显示之前不渲染对话框。
lazyRender.en-US: Used with keepDOM. When true, the dialog is not rendered until it is first shown.

maskClosable.zh-CN: 是否允许点击遮罩取消对话框。
maskClosable.en-US: Whether a click on the mask cancels the dialog.

maskFixed.zh-CN: 遮罩限定在自定义容器内时，是否仍以 fixed 定位覆盖整个视口并按模态处理（aria-modal、页面 inert、Tab 锁定、body 滚动锁定）。
maskFixed.en-US: Whether a mask confined to a custom container still covers the viewport with fixed positioning and is treated as modal (aria-modal, inert page, Tab lock, body scroll lock).

modalContentClass.zh-CN: 对话框内容元素的类名。
modalContentClass.en-US: Class name of the dialog content element.

motion.en-US: Whether the enter and leave animations run.

okButtonProps.zh-CN: 确认按钮的属性。autoFocus 为 true 时打开后聚焦该按钮；class、style 落在按钮上；onClick 先于内置的确认处理调用，不会替换内置处理。
okButtonProps.en-US: Props of the ok button. autoFocus focuses it on open; class and style land on the button; onClick runs before the built-in ok handling, which still runs.

okText.zh-CN: 确认按钮文字，缺省取语言包 Modal.confirm。
okText.en-US: Ok button text. Defaults to the locale entry Modal.confirm.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内部调用 focus 时是否阻止浏览器滚动到被聚焦元素，不影响使用方自己的 focus 调用。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the focus calls made by the component avoid scrolling the focused element into view. Focus calls made by the caller are not affected.

size.zh-CN: 对话框宽度档位：small 为 448px，medium 为 684px，large 为 920px，full-width 为 100vw - 64px。
size.en-US: Width preset of the dialog: small is 448px, medium 684px, large 920px, full-width 100vw - 64px.

title.zh-CN: 纯文本标题，同时作为对话框的可访问名称；同时传入 #title 插槽时以插槽为准。声明为 prop，不会作为原生 title 属性落到元素上。
title.en-US: Plain-text title, which also names the dialog. The #title slot wins when both are given. It is a declared prop, so it never lands on an element as the native title attribute.

visible.zh-CN: 对话框是否可见，配合 v-model:visible 使用。
visible.en-US: Whether the dialog is visible, used with v-model:visible.

width.zh-CN: 对话框宽度，数字按像素处理，字符串为合法 CSS 长度；不传时由 size 决定。
width.en-US: Width of the dialog. A number is in pixels; a string is any valid CSS length. When omitted, size decides.

onCancel.zh-CN: 取消按钮、关闭按钮、遮罩和 Esc 触发；按 Esc 时参数为原生 KeyboardEvent。返回 Promise 时取消按钮保持加载，fulfill 后才更新 v-model:visible，reject 时保持打开；回调执行时父级的 visible 仍为 true。保留为函数 prop 以读取返回值，使用方照常写 @cancel。
onCancel.en-US: Called by the cancel button, the close button, the mask and Esc; the argument is a native KeyboardEvent for Esc. A returned Promise keeps the cancel button loading; v-model:visible updates once it fulfills, and a rejection keeps the dialog open. The parent's visible is still true while the callback runs. It remains a function prop so its result can be read, bound with @cancel as usual.

onOk.zh-CN: 点击确认按钮时调用；返回 Promise 时确认按钮保持加载直到落定。组件不会自行关闭，由使用方把 visible 设为 false。保留为函数 prop 以读取返回值，使用方照常写 @ok。
onOk.en-US: Called when the ok button is clicked. A returned Promise keeps the ok button loading until it settles. The component never closes itself on ok; the caller sets visible to false. It remains a function prop so its result can be read, bound with @ok as usual.

update:visible.zh-CN: 取消路径（取消按钮、关闭按钮、遮罩、Esc）完成后触发，值为 false，供 v-model:visible 回写。确认只触发 onOk，不触发该事件。
update:visible.en-US: Emitted with false once a cancel path (cancel button, close button, mask, Esc) completes, for v-model:visible to write back. Ok only calls onOk and never emits this.

afterClose.zh-CN: 对话框完全关闭后触发；显示期间被卸载时也会触发一次。
afterClose.en-US: Emitted after the dialog has fully closed. It is also emitted once when the dialog is unmounted while shown.

title.zh-CN: 标题，优先于 title 属性，同时作为对话框的可访问名称。
title.en-US: Title. It wins over the title prop and names the dialog.

header.zh-CN: 完全替换默认头部（图标、标题与关闭按钮）。传入空插槽时隐藏头部区域。
header.en-US: Replaces the whole default header (icon, title and close button). An empty slot hides the header area.

footer.zh-CN: 完全替换默认页脚按钮。传入空插槽时隐藏页脚区域。
footer.en-US: Replaces the default footer buttons. An empty slot hides the footer area.

closeIcon.zh-CN: 关闭按钮中的图标；空插槽时回落到默认图标。
closeIcon.en-US: Icon inside the close button. An empty slot falls back to the default icon.

modal.zh-CN: 自定义渲染对话框本身，参数 modal 是 role=dialog 元素的 VNode，用 `<component :is="modal" />` 放置。
modal.en-US: Custom rendering of the dialog itself. The scope parameter modal is the VNode of the role=dialog element; place it with `<component :is="modal" />`.

root.zh-CN: Portal 内的最外层元素，未渲染时为 null。
root.en-US: The outermost element inside the portal, or null while nothing is rendered.
